introduce: Start with your feet together and your arms by your sides, then jump up with your feet apart and your hands overhead. \n\nReturn to the start position then do the next rep. This exercise provides a full-body workout and works all your large muscle groups.
name: JUMPING JACKS

tips.text: Bend your arms to bring your hands over your head.
Start at a slow speed, then gradually increase the pace.
Your arms shouldn't be straight when you raise them above your head.
Inhale when your feet are apart, and exhale when pulling them back.
If you feel it's too easy, add weight on your ankles.
If you feel it's too easy, jump as high as you can.
Your back, glutes, abs, shoulders and calves all get involved.
It's a full body exercise to strengthen your cardiovascular system.

introduce:
Stand on the floor, bend your legs slightly and lean your upper body forward. 

Then jump to the right. As you jump, bring your left foot behind you and your left arm in front of you. 

Then jump to the other side. Repeat the exercise.
name: SKATER JUMP

tips.text: Keep your back flat and your core tight.
Keep your shoulders back.
Don't lean your body forward too much.
Exhale when you jump, and inhale when you land.
You should feel your legs and butt burning.
This exercise can get your heart rate up.
This exercise is good for your cardiovascular system.
This exercise is great for your legs.

introduce: Stand on the floor, put your hands in front of you and hop from side to side.
name: SIDE HOP

tips.text: To increase the difficulty, perform it with a weighted vest.
Breathe regularly.
Do this exercise at a speed that makes you feel comfortable.
If it's too easy for you, you can add a squat in your side hop.
This exercise can get your legs involved and your heart rate up.
This is a nice cardiovascular home workout.

introduce: Stand up on the floor, then run in place while kicking your heel up to touch your butt with each step.\n\nTry to do it as fast as you can. It\'s a great exercise for the gluteus and hamstrings.
name: BUTT KICKS

tips.text: Please keep your chest up.
Please try to get your feet to touch your hips.
Please pull your shoulders back.
Please tighten your abs.
Please land on your toes.
Please try to do it as fast as you can.
Try to maintain a steady, rhythmic breathing pattern throughout the exercise.
Always remember to inhale deeply through the nose and exhale fully through the mouth.
It’s a cardio exercise that can strengthen your gluteus and hamstrings.

introduce:
Stand on the floor with your hands rested on your hips and your feet shoulder width apart. 

Lift your left leg up at waist level and bend your knee at a right angle. 

Then rotate your body to the left side and rotate back. Change sides and repeat the exercise.

Keep the toes of your standing leg facing forward. Your knees should face the same direction as your toes.
name: SINGLE LEG HIP ROTATION

tips.text: Please open your chest.
Make sure the knee and toes of your standing leg face forward.
Please squeeze your abs.
Your knees should face the same direction as your toes.
Exhale as you lift your leg and rotate your hip.
Inhale as you lower your leg.
This exercise works on your hips and improves hip stability.

introduce: Stand with your right hand on the wall. Bend your left leg and grasp your ankle or toes to bring your left calf close to your left thigh. Hold this position.
name: LEFT QUAD STRETCH WITH WALL

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please keep your upper body straight during the exercise.
Your lifted knee should always go straight down.
Focus on your breath and keep it steady and even throughout the stretch.
This exercise can stretch your quadriceps.

introduce: Stand with your left hand on the wall. Bend your right leg and grasp your ankle or toes to bring your right calf close to your right thigh. Hold this position.
name: RIGHT QUAD STRETCH WITH WALL

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please keep your upper body straight during the exercise.
Your lifted knee should always go straight down.
Focus on your breath and keep it steady and even throughout the stretch.
This exercise can stretch your quadriceps.

introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, and place your dominant foot slightly forward. Slightly bend your knees, clench your fists and bend your elbows at 90 degrees. \n\nRaise your right arm to shoulder height and keep your forearm parallel to the ground. Rotate your shoulders and hips and punch towards the left. Switch sides and repeat.
name: ALTERNATING HOOKS

tips.text: Keep your elbows at 90 degrees.
Rotate your shoulders and hips.
Keep your knees slightly bent.
Breathe in through the nose and out through the mouth.
Take quick and short breaths to maintain oxygen flow to the muscles.
Always keep your core engaged.

introduce:
Stand with your feet a little wider than shoulder width apart, elbows bent, palms facing each other and fingers pointed toward the ceiling. 

Lower your body until your thighs are parallel to the floor. When you come up, turn your body to the left, straighten your right leg, lift your right heel and stretch and reach your right arm to the left. 

Return to the start position, and repeat with the other side.
name: SQUAT REACH UPS

tips.text: Your knees should be extended in the same direction as your toes.
Squeeze your gluteus.
Your knees should not go over your toes.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
